  model asks:  issue_comment
                 id: 101
                 body: "Root cause found. auth.parseBearer splits on \" \" and indexes [1] without checking the result; a header of just \"Bearer\" (no token, e.g. the okhttp client in cr_f9ee9e) has length 1 and panics. Fix: auth/auth.go now uses strings.Cut and returns ok=false for a missing or empty token, so the request gets 401. Reproducer: auth/parsebearer_test.go (TestParseBearerMalformed), which panics on the original code. 3 reports, all POST /v1/reminders."
  model asks:  issue_comment
                 id: 102
                 body: "Root cause found. notify.Dispatcher.Stop calls close(d.stop) every time, so a second call to POST /v1/admin/dispatcher/stop panics. Fix: stop is closed inside a sync.Once (notify/notify.go), so Stop is idempotent. Reproducer: notify/stop_twice_test.go (TestStopTwice). 1 report, cr_fd4982."
  model asks:  issue_file
                 title: "store.Get returns nil with no error for a deleted reminder, so api.owned panics"
                 body: "Crash group fp_4828a6, 3 reports (cr_1e2ea0 x2, cr_ee551c), panic \"invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference\" in api.(*API).owned at api/reminders.go:144 (rem.UserID), reached from markDone (POST /v1/reminders/{id}/done) and getReminder (GET /v1/reminders/{id}).\n\nCause: store.(*Store).Get in store/store.go. For a tombstoned reminder (r.Deleted) it sets r = nil but leaves err nil, so it returns (nil, nil). owned only checks err, so it dereferences nil. Logs confirm the sequence: rem_0001 was DELETEd at 14:11:02, then GETs for it panicked at 14:12 to 14:15.\n\nFix: Get now sets err = ErrNotFound in the deleted case, so callers get a 404 as they do for a missing ID. Reproducer: store/get_deleted_test.go (TestGetDeletedReturnsNotFound), which fails on the original code."
                 fingerprint: "fp_4828a6"
